items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, public data display, alert expansion, affiliate or advertising expansion, and external outreach. Conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: 0 of 4 launch-readiness legal tasks are closed; upstream API access is documented but rights to store, derive, display, cache, alert on, or monetize the data are not established; compliance is a technical baseline with 34 pass, 14 fail, and 11 unknown; analytics is yellow; provider revenue includes $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable; security and operations sweeps have no results. Exact decision: keep the gated product private, keep external outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization, retain parked-site dispositions, and continue only existing read-only evidence work. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any future affiliate or advertising use. No go-live approval is supported.

Tracking remains active. Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; all four remain open: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. No task is closable on current evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.
